opd. A 65-year-old woman with pain at rest and positive clinical ergometry in the third stage of Bruce.
ope. A 55-year-old patient admitted for chest pain and dyspnea saturating 80% despite the administration of oxygen and with an ECG with ST-segment depression in the anterolateral aspect that does not revert with the administration of intravenous nitroglycerin.
